example.name: markable
example.source: Example 3. Romeo sends a message to Juliet

examples.example: <message to='juliet@capulet.lit' from='romeo@montegue.lit/orchard' id='the-msg-1'> <body>Hi. How are you?</body> <markable xmlns='urn:xmpp:chat-markers:0'/> <request xmlns='urn:xmpp:receipts'/> </message>

example.name: displayed
example.source: Example 4. Juliet lets both Romeo she has displayed the message

example.name: muc-markable
example.source: Example 5. Example MUC message with a markable Displayed Marker

examples.example: <message from='coven@chat.shakespeare.lit/firstwitch' to='coven@chat.shakespeare.lit' id='message-1' type='groupchat'> <thread>Act IV, Scene I</thread> <body>Thrice the brinded cat hath mew'd.</body> <markable xmlns='urn:xmpp:chat-markers:0' /> <stanza-id xmlns='urn:xmpp:sid:0' by='coven@chat.shakespeare.lit' id='39K7ZYIp' /> </message>

example.name: muc-displayed
example.source: Example 6. Example marker response to a markable MUC message

examples.example: <message from='coven@chat.shakespeare.lit/secondwitch' to='coven@chat.shakespeare.lit' id='message-2' type='groupchat'> <thread>Act IV, Scene I</thread> <displayed xmlns='urn:xmpp:chat-markers:0' id='39K7ZYIp'/> </message>
